properties.description: Increment 2 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory. Build, in a reflow2 release: cues placed on the agent's side of the interface (the kit's hooks at session start, before a tool and at stop, and the connect-time instructions), and an id on every cue with a count of whether the agent acted on it. Shaped by what increment 1's baseline shows. Not in it: renaming today's hints into one contract (increment 6).
properties.name: PLANNED (2 of 6) — cues reach the agent before its first call, and every cue is counted by whether the agent acted on it
